agreement: 3 runtime(s) labelled every event of every workload identically

rules.name: refused
rules.rule: the dispatch outcome is "rejected" (a reject rule, a bad payload, a bound or a limit): the transaction rolled back and the session is unchanged

rules.name: commit+reopen
rules.rule: accepted; the effects include both a commit and a reopen

rules.name: commit
rules.rule: accepted; the effects include a commit (a decision made or re-made)

rules.name: reopen
rules.rule: accepted; the effects include a reopen (a decision withdrawn for reconsideration)

rules.name: evidence
rules.rule: accepted; the effects include a reveal, sample, withdraw or examine (an observation entering or leaving the evidence graph), and no commit or reopen

rules.name: qualify
rules.rule: accepted; none of the above, and the effects include a qualify (a caveat learned late, applied to values already derived from the evidence)

rules.name: renew
rules.rule: accepted; none of the above, and the effects include a renew (renewable evidence given a new, unobserved occurrence)

rules.name: state-changing
rules.rule: accepted; no effects, but the save differs from the save before the event outside sequence, last_event, elapsed, effects and the workload's clock states (a decay, a counter, a scheduled change)

rules.name: idle
rules.rule: accepted; no effects, and the save differs only in sequence, last_event, elapsed, effects and the workload's clock states
